view.title: Sleeping Smith
view.text: A smith slumps over his anvil, hammer still loose in one hand. His forge is cold, but the blade laid across it hums like it remembers heat. He does not stir when you approach.

choices.label: Take the blade (upgrade a random card)
choices.resultText: The hum quiets the moment it leaves the anvil, as if it was only ever waiting for a hand.

choices.label: Wake him (pay 30 cinders, heal 12% max HP)
choices.resultText: He blinks awake just long enough to press a cold coin into your palm, and something in you settles.

choices.label: Leave
choices.resultText: You let him sleep. The blade goes on humming behind you.

outcome.resultText: The hum quiets the moment it leaves the anvil, as if it was only ever waiting for a hand.

view.title: Shrine of the Feral Ember
view.text: A shrine no church would recognize: antlers, wax, and old blood. Ember pools here anyway — wild, unattended, and guarded by something that has not left claw marks this fresh by accident.

choices.label: Take the offering (gain a random relic — its keeper objects)
choices.resultText: Your hand closes on the relic. Behind you, the undergrowth stands up.

choices.label: Leave
choices.resultText: Wild ember keeps its own accounts. You leave the ledger closed.

outcome.resultText: Your hand closes on the relic. Behind you, the undergrowth stands up.

view.title: Abandoned Merchant Cart
view.text: A trader’s cart lies tipped in the mud, one wheel still turning. Cinder-light glints from a split strongbox. The mud around it is churned with bootprints.

choices.label: Loot the strongbox (gain 75 cinders; the owners may object)
choices.resultText: You scoop the cinders from the mud. Behind you, someone clears their throat.

choices.label: Leave
choices.resultText: Not every gift is free. You keep walking.

outcome.resultText: You scoop the cinders from the mud. Behind you, someone clears their throat.

view.title: The Oracle's Riddle
view.text: A pair of enormous fingers rises from a font of still water, tapping a slow rhythm only they understand. Read one way, the rhythm sharpens the mind. Read another, it mends the flesh — but the second reading leaves a mark.

choices.label: Sharpen (upgrade 2 random cards, take 5 damage)
choices.resultText: The rhythm settles behind your eyes. Two of your cards come back keener; your hands ache with the knowing.

choices.label: Mend (heal 22% max HP, gain a Guilt curse)
choices.resultText: Warmth floods you, generous and total. Something reads back through the water, and does not look away.

choices.label: Leave
choices.resultText: The fingers tap on. You leave the riddle unanswered, which is its own kind of answer.

outcome.resultText: The rhythm settles behind your eyes. Two of your cards come back keener; your hands ache with the knowing.

view.title: Golden Moth
view.text: A moth the size of a shield rests on a broken pillar, wings dusted with cinder-light. It is dying, slowly and without complaint. Cinders drip from its wings like pollen.

choices.label: Gather the falling cinders (gain 40 cinders)
choices.resultText: The cinders come away easily. The moth watches you with something like approval.

choices.label: Sit with it a while (heal 10% max HP)
choices.resultText: You keep the vigil. When you rise, some of its lightness has passed to you.

choices.label: Leave
choices.resultText: Some deaths are not yours to attend.

outcome.resultText: The cinders come away easily. The moth watches you with something like approval.

view.title: Merchant's Ghost
view.text: A translucent figure keeps a stall that is no longer there, weighing wares no living hand can hold. "Custom," it sighs, almost grateful. "It has been so long. I have something you'll want."

choices.label: Take it and run (gain a random relic and a Guilt curse)
choices.resultText: It does not chase you. It only watches, and writes something down, and the writing follows you out.

choices.label: Leave
choices.resultText: "Come again," it says, to no one, already forgetting you.

outcome.resultText: It does not chase you. It only watches, and writes something down, and the writing follows you out.
